title: DogeSmartX
tagline: DogeSmartX: AI-enhanced cross-chain swaps for Ethereum and Dogecoin
description: DogeSmartX is a decentralized finance (DeFi) application designed to enable seamless cross-chain swaps between Ethereum and Dogecoin. By leveraging the power of 1inch's Fusion+ protocol, it allows users to efficiently and securely exchange tokens between these two distinct blockchains. What makes DogeSmartX unique is its integration of artificial intelligence, featuring an interactive chatbot that provides users with real-time market insights and recommendations for optimal swap timings. The platform also captures the playful essence of the Dogecoin community through a meme-themed interface and includes a charity donation feature, where a small portion of each swap fee is contributed to Dogecoin-related causes. Inspired by Elon Musk's influence on Dogecoin, DogeSmartX combines cutting-edge technology with a fun, community-driven spirit, making it a standout project in the DeFi space.
how_its_made:
DogeSmartX bridges Ethereum and Dogecoin with a seamless, user-friendly experience:

Cross-Chain Swaps: Ethereum swaps use Ethers.js and 1inch's API for optimal routing. Dogecoin swaps use hashed timelock contracts (HTLCs), adapted from Bitcoin scripts, ensuring secure trustless exchanges.

AI Chatbot: Powered by an LLM API, the chatbot offers insights using real-time market data and social sentiment tailored to Ethereum and Dogecoin.

Frontend & Backend: The frontend uses React with a meme-themed UI. The backend, built on Node.js, handles API calls, blockchain interactions, and AI data processing.

Blockchain Integration: Ethers.js supports Ethereum. For Dogecoin, we built a custom library from Bitcoin tools to manage HTLCs and transactions.

This tech stack makes DogeSmartX both powerful and fun to use.
